text: According to Rendleman, he was disappointed that the DDA didn’t go forward this year – it lost on a 4-4 Council tie – and he would have voted for it had he been on Council at the time.

text: Rendleman stated that he did not at first appreciate the high-rises being built in Boulder, but currently favors more development rather than sprawl.
